# 4ndra

> 4ndra (also called arch) is a student and developer from Indonesia who works as a Roblox game tester.

## About

Hi, I'm 4ndra. Some people call me arch. I'm from Indonesia and I'm a student. I work as a Roblox game tester for Sahabat Productions. I'm into cute things, and I'm also a developer who makes things. I play Roblox the most, and I play Minecraft too. I'm still learning and I'm not great at anything. My dream is to have a stable job. I'm a bit sensitive, so please be kind to me.
